dataset_metadata.count_scope: Frozen construction statistics; prompts and comparison cells are dependent surface realizations, not independent samples.

corpus.attribution: UD Turkish BOUN/TABILAB contributors listed in retained README.md; texts from Turkish National Corpus.
corpus.scope: All three corpus partitions used only for independent lexical frequency. News/nonfiction treebank selection; not general Turkish or model training distribution.

corpus.normalization: Unicode NFC; Turkish I→ı and İ→i; exact case-insensitive ngrams
corpus.zero_policy: No smoothing; measured zero counts retained; log10(0) and inverse-zero ratios null

limitations: Correlational, not causal or model-weight analysis.
Corpus genre/sense coverage is limited; root frequencies are not all P4 predicate frequencies.
Plain text, local chat template and provider-billed token scopes are distinct.
Prompt coverage is the bounded preview; missing/gated tokenizers remain null.
Few distinct lexical units; descriptive Spearman/OLS without iid inference.
lexical_preprocessing.preprocessing_scope: Independent corpus and isolated strings; no model-answer outcomes.

limitations: Human linguistic review remains pending; no output is eligible for confirmatory evaluation.
Runner journals establish recorded provenance, not independent attestation of provider execution.
Dataset prompts/comparison cells share latent structures and must not be counted as independent samples.
Corpus frequency associations are correlational, corpus-specific, and do not identify causal effects or model parameter weights.
Held-out training predicate vocabulary is disjoint, but English presentation contexts share higher/lower; full-context lexical novelty is not established.
The recorded environment did not run 7 Torch numerical/gradient tests; pure-Python tests do not establish autograd correctness.
CUDA/model training smoke validation remains unexecuted in the recorded environment; no training compatibility or training success is established.
No verified model responses are available. Model-performance tables, confidence intervals, significance tests and outcome figures are placeholders only.
